tasks.short: Maintain talent files with specialties, performance history and availability.

steps.what: Locate the correct performer file and existing source records in a native view
inputs: existing performer identities and dated talent records

steps.what: Collect and capture actual declared specialties, performance credits and dated availability responses
inputs: actual performer updates and production credit evidence

steps.what: Verify identity, credits, availability dates and the source of each changed field
Populate the draft talent file from exact checked update fields
Approve the complete updated talent file, source references and access scope
Commit the approved final talent file update

tasks.design: Configure a native talent-record view and exact-field draft import in the existing casting records system ({OTHER}). Keep collection, original capture, fact checking and final review explicit. Commit only the completed approved update; declared specialty and availability remain source-qualified facts, never inferred suitability scores.
tasks.previous_blocker: A name match or old credit does not verify a current performer update.
tasks.enabler_now: Native record forms can reuse exact checked fields without a second transcription.
tasks.still_hard: Ambiguous identities, unsupported credits and changed availability need human checks.
tasks.human_edge: Keep a performers actual declaration separate from a directors opinion of role fit.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated file entry with unchanged verification and casting judgement.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: casting records systems can store explicit credits, declared specialties and dated availability using native field mappings.

assumptions: Shares are provisional. Verify actual duplicated file entry and navigation; if staff already enter once into the native record, s4 benefit does not apply. Existing imports earn no new saving.

Performer supplies actual specialties and availability response; credited production sources supply performance evidence. s2 director captures performer_id, declared_specialty, credit, production, date, available_window, response_date and source_reference at full time. s3 resolves identity/meaning, not model-generated tags.

s4 maps only checked fields; unsupported import or unknown values remain manual. s5 checks the complete candidate record before a1 binds its version and access scope. Changes revoke approval. No model ranking, candidate selection, public profile or external message.
Native talent-record controls precede code; new staff/performer data-entry labour is not shifted outside the denominator.
research_questions: Which talent fields are entered twice rather than captured once in the current native form?

incremental.description: Check identity/source field mappings and stale availability flags

approvals.approved_version: s5 complete final talent update and access scope

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central saves 4 navigation, 15 repeat entry and 5 commit hours minus 1 upkeep = 23. Low halves repeat-entry benefit and keeps other actions manual: 7.5 minus 1 = 6.5.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Read scripts and confer with producers about required performer types and numbers.

steps.what: Read the actual script for characters, scenes, dramatic needs and performance demands
outputs: human script and performance requirements understanding

steps.what: Prepare and check character/scene counts using explicit script role labels in native breakdown tools
inputs: human script and performance requirements understanding

steps.what: Confer with producers on actual performer types, numbers, doubling and production constraints
inputs: human script and performance requirements understanding

steps.what: Write and approve final performer requirements and unresolved creative questions
Save the approved final performer requirement note
Send the approved requirement note to internal producers

tasks.design: Use native script-breakdown tools ({OTHER}) only to count explicit consistent character/scene labels. Keep script interpretation, creative performer requirements and the producer conversation human; retain correction of ambiguous labels. Write/check the final actual requirements before separate save and internal send, with no automated casting or performer inference.
tasks.previous_blocker: A named-character count does not decide performer types, extras, doubling or creative needs.
tasks.enabler_now: Native breakdown tools can count explicit structured screenplay labels while preserving source locations.
tasks.still_hard: Dramatic intent and feasible staffing require reading and producer discussion.
tasks.human_edge: Identify where one script role needs a particular performance ability that a label cannot describe.
tasks.altitude: Less mechanical breakdown counting; unchanged creative discussion.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native screenplay tools can list explicit character/scene labels without interpreting dramatic performer requirements.

assumptions: Shares are provisional. Verify actual repeated mechanical counting after current tools; an existing breakdown earns no new benefit.

Writer supplies the actual versioned script and its existing explicit role/scene labels. s2 director selects/checks version, labels and scene associations in retained 10 hours per provisional 100, resolving aliases manually. Inconsistent/unstructured scripts use full manual breakdown with no s2 saving; no free role tagging is assumed.

s1 retains full reading and s3 actual creative discussion. s4 separately captures final role types, numbers, doubling decisions, source version and unresolved questions at full time before a1/a2. The discussion outcome is not invented from a count.
a1/a2 bind complete final note versions and their own destinations; edits revoke approval. Native tools precede code; no performer ranking or external casting notice.
research_questions: Which character/scene counts can the native script tool generate from labels the writer already supplied?

approvals.approved_version: s4 final requirement note and source script version
s4 final requirement note and internal producer recipients

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central saves 10 mechanical breakdown, 3 save and 2 send hours minus 1 upkeep = 14. Low halves breakdown benefit and keeps transfers manual: 5 minus 1 = 4. Reading and discussion unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Attend or view productions to learn about available actors.

steps.what: Find relevant productions and verify current cast credits in a native listings view
inputs: existing production listings and published cast credits

steps.what: Attend or view the actual production and observe actors performances in context
Write personal performance observations and distinguish impressions from verified credits
Check and approve the completed viewing note, performer identities and source context
Save the approved actual production viewing note

tasks.design: Use a native production-listings/cast-credit view ({OTHER}) to reduce finding/navigation work. Retain full actual viewing and personal performance interpretation; write/check viewing notes separately before an approved save in {DOCS}. A listed credit does not imply current performer availability or substitute for seeing the work.
tasks.previous_blocker: A cast list cannot convey the actual performance or its context.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing listing filters can show relevant productions and their published cast references together.
tasks.still_hard: Knowledge of a performers work depends on direct attention and judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise an unexpected quality in an actual performance that a profile would miss.
tasks.altitude: Small listing-navigation savings; unchanged production viewing.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: listings views can filter existing production/cast metadata but cannot replace watching a performance.

assumptions: Shares are provisional. Verify actual listings lookup and note save; existing native filters earn no new benefit.

Production/listing publisher supplies production_id, title, date, cast names and credit sources. s1 director maintains interests and verifies references in retained time; missing credits require manual checking, not inferred identity. No new free cast tagging.

s2 viewing stays full time. s3 separately captures actual production/date/performer, observations, personal interpretation and source context; it does not assert current availability. s4 approves the complete note before a1; edits revoke approval.

This is a personal viewing record; transfer into a shared talent file is the separate maintenance task and cannot be counted twice. Native view/document functions precede code; no model performer evaluation.
research_questions: Does the existing listing source already show the relevant cast references alongside each production?

incremental.description: Check listing-source coverage and identity references

approvals.approved_version: s4 completed actual viewing note and source references

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central saves 3 listing-navigation and 1 note-save hours minus 0.5 upkeep = 3.5. Low halves navigation and keeps save manual: 1.5 minus 0.5 = 1. Actual viewing and writing unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Review the current scene plan and technical cue references in a native production view
inputs: existing approved scene plans and technical cues

steps.what: Direct rehearsals, interpret scenes and coach the actual performers and production team
Direct the actual show and respond to artistic, timing and technical changes
Write actual direction notes, creative changes and follow-up issues
Check and approve the complete actual direction note
Save the approved actual production direction note

tasks.design: Configure a native current-plan/cue reference view in the existing production management system ({OTHER}). Keep creative interpretation, rehearsal coaching, live directing and substantive direction-note writing human. Check/approve the complete actual note before its separate save; no cue is automatically fired and no artistic choice is inferred.
tasks.previous_blocker: A plan cannot anticipate an actual performance or determine the right creative response.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing scene/cue references can be shown together with their current versions.
tasks.still_hard: Performance, timing, collaboration and live changes require direct creative judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Change the direction when the scene works differently in the room than on the page.
tasks.altitude: Small reference-navigation savings with unchanged artistic direction.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: production-management views can consolidate current scene and cue references without directing a performance.

assumptions: Shares are provisional. Verify actual cross-document plan lookup and note saving; existing native views earn no new benefit. No rehearsing or live direction time is reduced.

Existing script/production and technical owners supply scene_id, cue_id, plan_revision, cue_reference and current_status under their current work. s1 retains reading, interpretation and missing-reference checks; no free new tagging or cue programming. Absent reliable versions use manual references.

s2/s3 director produces actual rehearsal/show observations. s4 separately captures scene, actual direction, reason, issue and follow-up at full time. s5 checks the complete note before a1; changes revoke approval.
Native views/documents precede code. Saving a note does not issue revised cues or a live instruction; actual performer/team direction remains human in s2/s3.
research_questions: Can the current production system show scene and technical cue references without repeated manual navigation?

approvals.approved_version: s5 complete actual production direction note

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central saves 3 plan-navigation and 1 note-save hours minus 0.5 upkeep = 3.5. Low halves navigation and keeps note save manual: 1.5 minus 0.5 = 1. Creative direction and writing unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Keep talent knowledge and artistic judgement human while maintaining exact current production records.
reach: Help producers distinguish actual performer evidence, creative requirements and current production decisions.
role.ambitious_version: A talent director who knows the work and performers directly and spends less time repeating verified production facts.
